description: The creator's own planned team of Kingdra with Annihilape, with a debated third slot leaning toward Azumarill to handle the mirror Azu. Non-shadow Annihilape runs Low Kick (a Vine Whip clone) to spam Rage Fist into double Close Combat.
performanceNotes: Kingdra + Annihilape as the intended backbone
Azu added to deal with opposing Azumarill
Low Kick fast move enables Rage Fist spam into double Close Combat

description: Mantine-based team paired with Guzzlord, with Pawmot added to handle Azumarill since Mantine struggles against it. Mantine runs the newly-buffed Twister over Ice Beam.
performanceNotes: Pawmot fields Azu because Azu lacks fast-move pressure
Buffed Twister replaces Ice Beam on Mantine
Weak to Quagsire, which has Stone Edge for Mantine and Mud Shot for Pawmot

description: Mandibuzz-centered team where an electric type (Morpeko) pairs with the flying Mandibuzz to cover ground threats, with Sableye added to avoid being overly vulnerable to electric. Morpeko runs Seed Bomb over Psychic Fang so it can beat Quagsire.
performanceNotes: Electric + flying duo covers ground while Mandibuzz walls ground types
Seed Bomb Morpeko removes Quagsire as a counter
Sableye reduces electric vulnerability and destroys Annihilape
